title.narrative: Enhancement of National HIV Response with Focus on Target Beneficiary Groups in line with fifth National Strategic Plan 2020-2024 - Iran (Islamic Republic) (01-Apr-2021-31-Mar-2024)

description.narrative: Iran (Islamic Republic), HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Iran)This program has the following goals: By the end of 2023, maintain the HIV prevalence among PWIDs at less than 5%. By the end of 2023, maintain the HIV prevalence among people who are exposed to sexual transmission of HIV at less than 5%. By the end of 2023, decrease the AIDS mortality by 20%. The objectives of this program are: By the end of 2023, at least 60% of the PWIDs use sterilized and non-shared devices for injection in their last injection. By the end of 2023, the percentage of condom use in the last sex among people who are at the highest risk of sexual transmission increases by 20%. By the end of 2023, at least 92% of people living with HIV and started their treatment a year ago, retain their treatment
